description:
A single launcher that combines the Windows software tools for WyreStorm products

WyreStorm Management Suite combines the software tools for WyreStorm products, including NetworkHD 100, 200, 400, 500 and 600 Series AV over IP, CAM-200-PTZ conference camera, SP-0108-SCL splitter and CON-H2 converters. With no separate utilities to manage, integrators only have to maintain a single application to ensure they have the most up to date version of all WyreStorm configuration software.
- NetworkHD Series Console — Config software for NetworkHD AV over IP systems. Discover NetworkHD endpoints and quickly apply settings across multiple devices simultaneously. Configure NetworkHD Touch zone, display and source names, and configure video walls and scenes for NetworkHD Touch and other control systems.
- PTZ Camera Control — Simple to use software for setup, control & configuration of the CAM-200-PTZ. Save up to 255 custom PTZ presets that can be recalled from control panels, adjust pan and tilt speeds to your preference and send custom API commands for testing and troubleshooting.
- CON-H2 Configuration Tool — Configuration tool for CON-H2-EDID & CON-H2-SCL. Configure, read and write EDID files. Test and configure CEC, RS-232 and Relay commands. Set output resolution for video scaler and other control systems.
- SP-0108-SCL Configuration Software — Configuration software for the SP-0108-SCL. Configure, test set and get API functions, import EDID files, update software and much more to get up and running or troubleshoot issues.
- Maintenance Tool — Batch firmware update utility for NetworkHD components and ScreenLink supporting presentation switchers.
WMS 2.5
Console 9.1.23: Fixed NHD-400-E-RX video scaling drop down menu that would not populate output timings; fixed an issue that would cause special characters to appear in device aliases.
Maintenance Tool v5.1.7: Fixed NHD-600 series that would fail to upgrade.
SP-0108-SCL Configuration Tool: initial release.
Test Kit Generator and Test Kit Analyzer Console removed from the management suite launcher.
